title: Congruous
summary: CONGRUOUS, adjective [Latin] 1. Suitable; consistent; agreeable to. Light airy music and a solemn or mournful occasion are not congruous Obedience to God is congruous to the light of reason. 2. Ration

inlines.v: CONGRUOUS, adjective [Latin] 1. Suitable; consistent; agreeable to. Light airy music and a solemn or mournful occasion are not congruous Obedience to God is congruous to the light of reason. 2. Rational; fit. It is not congruous that God should be always frightening men into an acknowledgment of the truth.
